description: 🎓 GRADUATE a tested surface into a dedicated, DEPLOYER-ONLY standing app in YOUR OWN Google Apps Script account. Returns a deterministic recipe (config files + clasp ops + least-privilege scopes derived from the atoms + verify) — you run it with your own clasp; nothing runs on our side, we hold no creds.

app_name.description: Name for the Apps Script project and its folder. Defaults to the payload title, else "A2UI App".

payload.description: The tested A2UI payload to bake into the standing app as its home surface: {title, theme, blocks:[...]}.

name: emit_deployment

files.description: File name to file content for the Apps Script project (HomeSurface.gs, appsscript.json).

scopes.description: OAuth scopes derived from the atoms.

ops.description: Ordered shell steps to build and deploy.

renderer_source.description: Where to fetch the open renderer.

required_catalogs.description: Catalog URIs the payload needs (base catalog first).

verify.description: How to check the deployed app.
